high_level_description: This image depicts a modern architectural complex situated along a waterfront. The buildings feature a contemporary design with a mix of materials, including glass, metal, and what appears to be a combination of brick and wood. The most striking aspect is the use of blue-tinted glass panels that cover many of the building's facades, giving it a distinctive and vibrant appearance. The buildings are multi-storied and have a modular structure, with some sections appearing to be stacked or layered on top of each other.
